coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: All three ground-truth variable items are present: BBH is the fixed benchmark, alignment criteria are EM versus MinED, and the dependent measure is the average performance across all 27 BBH tasks, expressed as macro-average accuracy.
coverage.design_error_analysis: No required variable is missing. The output adds controls, auxiliary metrics, threshold rules, and ablation studies not specified in the ground truth; these are unnecessary elaborations rather than missing core design elements.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The system failed to state that the proposed minimum-edit-distance MinED method consistently outperforms the exact-matching EM method introduced by Fu et al. (2023). Conditional decision criteria in the design do not supply the missing conclusion.
